pages.title: π
pages.text: $(thing)π$()$(br2)The ratio of every circle's circumference to its width, the same for all of them, and never ending or repeating. Archimedes trapped it between polygons. Unlocks the π Crystal.

$(thing)Insight$(): 35$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Euclid's Elements.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Rational Field.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A regular polygon of n sides is drawn inside a circle of diameter 1. Write its perimeter P.
